segments.comment: save.c dosave0(): create_savefile() of save/<uid><plname> where plname, cut to 31 bytes by unixmain.c process_options(), ends with the first two bytes of a three-byte UTF-8 character. APFS refuses a name that is not UTF-8, so on macOS the save may fail with "Cannot open save file." (save.c:128-132) and dosave() docrt()s; on Linux it saves. The save is the last key so the Linux recording can complete.
